description: burrow_run_lost on gke-live: first dispatch of warren-42f1 (run_2ty68jhvnvcb) was lost by the runtime ~8 min in; work discarded. Immediate re-dispatch with the identical prompt succeeded. Pattern: treat burrow_run_lost as infra, not agent failure — re-dispatch immediately, do not re-scope the prompt.
resolution: Re-dispatched same prompt (run_070b3421rpmg) -> PR #775 merged. Filed warren-30eb to classify the loss and consider one auto-retry at reap.

name: dogfood-pipeline-sequential-merge-gates
description: Dogfood pipeline round 2 (pl-882c, 14 issues, PRs #773-#786): sequential dispatch with merge gates completes a 14-child dependency plan in one session. Costs: kimi-k3 issue runs $0.26-$3.84 (big refactors 45-51 min), conflict-repair runs $0.10-$0.60. Every PR that outlived another merge went DIRTY on .seeds/issues.jsonl — repair-run-on-branch resolved 6/6 with zero lost seed closes when the prompt names both sides' close states explicitly. GitHub mergeability reads UNKNOWN for ~1 min after a repair push; re-check before diagnosing.

Warren run pods re-baseline bundle budgets ~1.3-1.5KB gzip LOWER than CI for identical source — the agent image toolchain gzips cooler than CI, and 'rm -rf src/ui/node_modules' does NOT fix it (proven by run_hk0cva2nbx09: wrote 195795, CI measured 197140). Every pod-written budget then fails CI, and since lowering always applies, pods actively corrupt correct budgets.
resolution: Never trust a pod-written bundle budget. Re-baseline from a CI-matching machine (laptop clean build == CI byte-for-byte), or for a many-PR UI plan push a documented session headroom bump to main once and have the final sweep ratchet down from a LOCAL clean build. Filed warren-6397.

description: GLM-5.3/openrouter on pi hung mid-turn (no stream data) for 45min; warren watchdog (heartbeatTimeoutMs 45min) eventually killed it at $2.38 with work discarded. A later socket-close during a turn WAS caught instantly as provider_error and auto-retried by the provider-retry consumer — only the silent-hang case burns money.
resolution: Filed warren-1f85 (turn-level inactivity abort + salvage-before-destroy for timed_out). When re-dispatching a big server-side task after a hang, add concrete file-size/scope guidance to the prompt — the re-dispatch of warren-1b40 with the route-table 500-line hint finished in 18min at $0.49.

name: dogfood-max-parallel-pr-shepherding
description: Dogfood pipeline max-parallel PR shepherding (pl-3ce8 13 issues + pl-4ab6 25 issues, 2026-08-27): dispatch every unblocked issue at once, then treat PR merge as a serial drain — after EVERY merge to main, batch-heal all open sibling branches in one worktree loop (git merge origin/main; budgets conflict -> take main's; .seeds merges via driver; verify check:seeds-integrity; push) and re-arm auto-merge. For bundle budgets under many parallel UI PRs, one documented headroom bump pushed straight to main kills the per-PR budget chase; the plan's final sweep ratchets it back down. ~24 heal cycles for 25 PRs; zero lost seed closes.
